name: 55802 · Duluth, MN
findings: ZIP 55802 (Duluth) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55802 (Duluth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
72% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
